title: +*INTRODUCTION TO PLANT BIOLOGY
description: Explores plant diversity from evolutionary perspective of the life cycles of four major groups of plants: Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Angiosperms and Gymnosperms. Focuses on mechanisms of evolution and cellular mechanisms of growth, development and responses to biotic and abiotic cues.
